items.stem: In Michaelis-Menten kinetics, what does the Km value represent?

options.text: The substrate concentration at which the reaction rate is half of Vmax
options.rationale: Correct: Km is the substrate concentration at half-maximal rate.

options.text: The total amount of enzyme present
options.rationale: Km is a concentration parameter, not enzyme quantity.

options.text: The rate constant for product release only
options.rationale: Km combines several rate constants, not just product release.

items.explanation: Correct: Km is the substrate concentration at half-maximal rate.
